standard_prerequisites: the extension by zero functors j_! for an etale morphism j : U to X of algebraic spaces, constructed termwise on complexes of O_X-modules (sites-modules-lemma-extension-by-zero of Modules on Sites)
core_obligations: For an etale morphism j : U to X, an etale V to Y (with Y = X context of the lower shriek setup), W = V x_X U and j_W : W to V, the restriction of j_!E to V equals j_{W!}(E|_W) for every complex E in D(O_U).
The proof reduces to the module-level identity (j_!F)|_V = j_{W!}(F|_W), which holds by the construction of the extension by zero functors.
proof_roadmap: Recall the module-level commutation of extension by zero with restriction from the construction lemma.
Pass to complexes degree-wise, since j_! is defined termwise and restriction is exact.
